description.value: The Sandman Hotel Abbotsford Airport is a full-service chain hotel situated adjacent to Abbotsford International Airport (YXX), offering rooms and suites with fridges, microwaves, and in some cases full kitchens. The property features an indoor pool, fitness centre, on-site Denny's Restaurant and Bar One Lounge, and a 24-hour front desk. It has earned Silver Certification from GreenStep Solutions under Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards, reflecting a documented commitment to environmental practices.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content was successfully fetched and provides detailed amenity and room listings. It confirms free Wi-Fi, on-site Denny's Restaurant and Bar One Lounge for evening food, USB charging ports in rooms, free overnight parking, and an indoor pool and fitness centre, but makes no mention of bike-specific storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any other cycling-oriented services. OSM tags align with the website on hotel status and free Wi-Fi; no contradictions were noted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational full-service hotel with an active website showing current room listings and bookings. Useful to touring cyclists as overnight accommodation with free parking and on-site food.

Nearby evening food.detail: Denny's Restaurant and Bar One Lounge both listed as on-site dining options

Device charging.detail: USB Charging Ports listed as a room feature in the Grand Room description
